description: Short-life deaths for fateNeglect, following 'no one noticed when you began to develop #disease#.' #employer# and #workplace# are the ones set at the start of the fate.
deathNeglectShort: Before you had seen your twentieth winter the #disease# had hollowed you out entirely, and you were found one morning slumped over your duties in the #workplace#, so slight a figure that the #employer# at first mistook you for a heap of rags. The coroner recorded the cause as #diagnosis#.
